description: Return the element that currently has focus as { ref, role, name }, or focused: null when nothing (or only the body) is focused. Useful after a Tab press or to confirm focus moved. Returns: { ok, session_id, focused }. Errors: TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (multiple sessions).

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_focused_element
title: Get the focused element
